title: Pencil
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pencil body -->
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='20' height='52' fill='#f5c542' rx='2'/>
  <!-- body shading stripe -->
  <rect x='40' y='20' width='5' height='52' fill='#ffe08a' rx='2'/>
  <rect x='55' y='20' width='5' height='52' fill='#d9a521' rx='2'/>
  <!-- wooden tip -->
  <polygon points='40,72 60,72 50,90' fill='#f2d9b0'/>
  <!-- wood shading -->
  <polygon points='40,72 50,72 50,90' fill='#e3c193'/>
  <!-- graphite tip -->
  <polygon points='45,82 55,82 50,90' fill='#5a5470'/>
  <polygon points='45,82 50,82 50,90' fill='#736c8c'/>
  <!-- metal ferrule -->
  <rect x='40' y='12' width='20' height='10' fill='#b8c2cc' rx='1'/>
  <rect x='40' y='14' width='20' height='2' fill='#dae3ea'/>
  <rect x='40' y='19' width='20' height='2' fill='#9aa5b0'/>
  <!-- eraser -->
  <rect x='40' y='4' width='20' height='9' fill='#f28ca8' rx='3'/>
  <rect x='40' y='4' width='7' height='9' fill='#ffb3c8' rx='3'/>
</svg>
